build_MaskTrackRCNN: build a MaskTrackRCNN model with detector, track_head, and tracker configs for video instance segmentation
run_MaskTrackRCNN_loss: run the MaskTrackRCNN loss method to calculate RPN, detection, and tracking losses on key and reference frames
run_MaskTrackRCNN_predict: run the MaskTrackRCNN predict method to perform frame-by-frame video instance segmentation and tracking inference
review_MaskTrackRCNN_init: review the MaskTrackRCNN constructor that builds detector, track_head, and tracker submodules from config dicts
refactor_MaskTrackRCNN_predict: refactor the MaskTrackRCNN predict method to support batch sizes greater than one per GPU
